        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {

                }

                    return;
                }

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {

                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');

                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;

                    }

                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {

                }

<div class="item">
	<div class="title">Click/Call & Collect available</div>
	<div class="description">Cessnock City Libraries has a Click/Call & Collect service to ensure our community has access to reading material, entertainment and educational resources.</div>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>
